notes.title: HOUSE OF MOIRÉ OFFICIAL RELEASE DATE: June 30
notes.notes:
We're back, and after months of waiting, we're ready to open the doors to House of Moiré!

Click on the link below for a preview:

[previewyoutube=SVVlnE5VhA4;full][/previewyoutube]

House of Moiré takes us into a surreal house with multiple rooms, all unique and enigmatic. Can you unravel the sonic and visual mysteries behind each one?

Observe and listen to the whispers emanating from the walls, floors and ceilings. Let yourself be drawn in by the optical patterns. Immerse yourself this shapeshifting world, constantly in motion. 


Join us at House of Moiré on Friday June 30 at 9:00AM PST for the official release!
